presets.name: Endless bow
presets.description: A violin section's bow held still forever, gently drifting: Place moves along the note, Shimmer lifts grains an octave.

presets.name: Tremolo glitter
presets.description: Tremolo violins scattered into a glittering cloud, a share of grains an octave up: Density thickens it, the mod wheel too.

presets.name: Piano afterglow
presets.description: A grand piano's ring frozen just after the hammer, warm and still, a quarter of its grains backwards.

presets.name: Horn cathedral
presets.description: French horns as a slow cloud of swelling grains, each rising late and falling away, under a long attack.

presets.name: Organ halo
presets.description: A soft organ with a halo of octaves above it, the upper grains darker than the note.

presets.name: Reed ensemble
presets.description: An oboe and a clarinet blended grain by grain into one reed section; Blend leans it to either.

presets.name: Bowed vibes
presets.description: A vibraphone's ring frozen into a bowed, endless tone, steady as glass.

presets.name: Harp halo
presets.description: A harp's ring held and spread into a suspended second chord around each note.

presets.name: Low fog
presets.description: Cellos an octave down in a slow, dark cloud that rolls in under everything.

presets.name: Flute air
presets.description: Flute breath and tone scattered wide into a soft, airy wash; Air brings up the breath.

presets.name: Glass choir
presets.description: Wine glasses blooming into a choir, some grains an octave below for body.

presets.name: Viola mist
presets.description: Violas stretched to a tenth of their speed into a slowly turning mist.

presets.name: Rosin dust
presets.description: Crackles of bowed attacks scattered in the dark, every one a different bow.

presets.name: Reed wind
presets.description: A harmonica's breath turned to wind blowing through a narrow band that wanders.

presets.name: Starfield
presets.description: A glockenspiel scattered into stars on a ninth chord, some of them falling backwards.

presets.name: Muted embers
presets.description: Muted trumpet glowing in fragments, sparse and ringing, smouldering low.

presets.name: Timpani storm
presets.description: A timpani roll an octave down rumbling like distant thunder, heavy and dark.

presets.name: Kalimba drops
presets.description: Kalimba notes dropping slowly around you, each a note of the song's key.

presets.name: Tuned bows
presets.description: Cellos rung through a resonator on every grain, each tuned to a note of the song's key: a harp made of bows.

presets.name: Wood swarm
presets.description: Xylophone attacks in a dense, buzzing swarm, like insects in a hollow log.

presets.name: Bell clusters
presets.description: Tubular bells stretched to a crawl until they become slowly turning organ clusters.

presets.name: Cathedral drone
presets.description: A full organ an octave down, held by Latch, its position drifting so the stops seem to breathe.

presets.name: Abyss
presets.description: A double bass bowing two octaves down, smoothed into a bottomless, slowly moving floor.

presets.name: Smeared piano
presets.description: A piano an octave down smeared into a continuous, faintly worn tone.

presets.name: Tuba earth
presets.description: A tuba's voice an octave down at any note, its character slowly opening and closing.

presets.name: Harmonic field
presets.description: Hold one note and Latch spreads it into the song's chord on that degree, played by violas and cellos.

presets.name: Held strike
presets.description: The very moment a piano's hammer strikes, held in a loop for as long as the key is down.

presets.name: Tape strings
presets.description: Violins on a worn tape loop that wanders back and forth through the note, a little hiss in the grain.

presets.name: Infinite piano
presets.description: A piano that plays its attack as recorded and then never fades: the note simply stays.

presets.name: Harpsichord shards
presets.description: Harpsichord attacks broken into shards an octave apart, glinting around each note.

presets.name: Strummed pizzicato
presets.description: Each key strums a major seventh chord of violin plucks, the notes arriving one after another.

presets.name: Marimba bloom
presets.description: A marimba's stroke blooming into a soft haze as its playhead slows and half its grains turn back.

presets.name: Glass mallet
presets.description: Struck glass: a bright attack and a short ring, played like a mallet instrument.

presets.name: Kalimba echoes
presets.description: Kalimba notes that repeat on the song's dotted eighths and fade, a granular echo.

presets.name: Plucked upright
presets.description: A double bass pluck played through in grains: round, woody and short.

presets.name: Vowel oboe
presets.description: An oboe as an oscillator: any note, its reed voice kept; the mod wheel turns its vowel.

presets.name: Muted wah
presets.description: A muted trumpet as an oscillator whose voice opens with each note, a wah in its grains.

presets.name: Singing violin
presets.description: A violin that sings any line legato, a vibrato coming in as each note holds.

presets.name: Grit sax
presets.description: A tenor sax lead with grit in every grain, each crushed a little differently.

presets.name: Buzz harmonica
presets.description: A harmonica turned into a buzzing reed lead, its filter snapping open on each note.

presets.name: Horn lead
presets.description: A French horn as a warm, round lead that glides between notes.

presets.name: Bassoon bass
presets.description: A bassoon an octave down as a mono bass, its voice lifted to stay clear in a mix.

presets.name: Trombone growl
presets.description: A trombone bass with a growl under it, a ring an octave below each grain.

presets.name: Tuba mono
presets.description: A round, deep tuba bass that slides between notes.

presets.name: Pedal buzz
presets.description: An organ pedal turned into a buzzing, driven bass.

presets.name: Spiccato machine
presets.description: A cello section's bounced bows sequenced in swung sixteenths, each step a different stroke.

presets.name: Tremolo stutter
presets.description: Tremolo violins chopped in thirty-seconds, stuttering four times, jumping place on every sixteenth.

presets.name: Marimba shuffle
presets.description: Swung sixteenths of marimba wandering over the song's key, every note from a different stroke.

presets.name: Timpani fills
presets.description: Timpani strokes in eighths, each repeated and sliding down, for falling tom-like fills.

presets.name: Reverse pump
presets.description: Horn swells pumping on the eighths like a sidechained pad, each grain rising into the beat.

presets.name: Glitch organ
presets.description: An organ fired at random, never on a clock, square-cut and crushed: a stuttering broken machine.

presets.name: Tremolo riser
presets.description: Hold a note and tremolo violins rise over eight seconds: thicker, higher, brighter, wider.

presets.name: Falling shards
presets.description: Glass-bright glockenspiel grains each falling an octave as it fades.

presets.name: Grain stop
presets.description: Cellos play normally, then slow to a halt over a few seconds, dropping in pitch like a stopping tape.

presets.name: Hold the moment
presets.description: Violins that play as recorded until the mod wheel freezes them where they are.

presets.name: Impact tail
presets.description: A timpani stroke whose tail becomes stretched, ringing bells.

presets.name: Piano into organ
presets.description: A piano that turns into an organ as you push the mod wheel, grain by grain.

presets.name: Gamelan vibes
presets.description: Vibraphone rung into gamelan-like metal, each grain at its own clangorous ratio.

presets.name: Song scan
presets.description: Violins read once through every four bars, following the song wherever it plays.

presets.name: Breath drone
presets.description: A harmonica held by Latch, each note you add joining a slow, breathing drone.
